background.title: Background
background.description: B.Tech in Computer Science from IIIT Sricity. Software engineer with experience building and scaling backend and cloud-native systems where performance, efficiency, and reliability are critical. I’ve contributed to redesigning systems to support 10× growth in data and traffic and improving AI-driven workflows to achieve ~90% cost reduction. Experienced across multiple technology stacks including Go, Docker, Kafka, Flutter, Next.js, and AWS/GCP, with a strong ability to adapt quickly and deliver stable, production-ready solutions.

sections.title: How I Think
sections.description: I approach problems like systems — break them down, design for scale, and keep the user experience at the center. Whether it’s tuning APIs for faster responses, making cost-efficient architectural decisions, or balancing clean code with delivery speed, I focus on building things that are reliable, explainable, and built to grow.

sections.title: What I've Shipped
sections.description: Mobile features that boosted engagement, a Next.js platform that cut operational costs by 25%, backend systems redesigned to handle 10× data growth, AI workflows optimized to reduce inference costs by ~90%, real-time order platforms powering thousands of transactions, and a streaming engine pushing nearly a gigabyte per second. I’ve shipped across Flutter, Go, Docker, Kafka, and GCP/AWS — from hackathon-winning AI tools to production systems used at scale.
